story.title: Becky and Buster
paragraphs_en: One day Becky was playing in the living room when she saw from the window someone coming towards their house. She wondered "Who it could be? "When she looked carefully, she got excited to see her grandmother outside her house.

Becky was happy and excited as she loved her grandmother who always used to play with her. Becky ran towards the door to greet grandma. As she was about to open the door, Becky heard the sound of a dog.

Becky thought maybe grandma got her dog 'Ginger' along , but when she opened the door ........ Wow!!!!Becky saw a puppy in her grandmother's lap. Becky was excited as well as confused and eager to find out whose puppy was grandma carrying?

Becky asked, " Grandma where did you get this puppy from?, " Whose puppy is this?" Grandma smiled and said, " This is your puppy Becky, I got it for you." Becky was thrilled to hear this. She always wanted to have a puppy. Becky hugged grandma and took the puppy.

Becky played with grandma and the puppy all day. Grandma asked, "Becky , what are you going to name the puppy?" Becky thought for a while....hm..hm..hm... and then with excited tone replied," BUSTER"!!.

It was night everyone had dinner and went off to sleep. Becky and Buster were sleeping in Becky's room. Whoosh.....Whooosh....., Becky heard a voice, she got up to see. She looked at Buster and said," Who was making this noise?"
Buster sat next to Becky and said," I need your help." Becky was frightened and looked carefully. "Yes , its Buster who is talking....." she got excited, now her puppy could talk.

Buster said sadly,"I need your help, Becky, I love my mother and I am missing her, I want to go back to her." He looked upset and asked, "Can you take me back to her, please?"Becky was sad and told him she will definitely help him.

Next morning when grandma was going back Becky asked her Grandma ,"Can me and Buster come along with you to spend sometime at your house?" Grandma agreed and said, "Yes, of course!"Becky got thrilled to hear that.

When they reached grandma's house Becky saw Ginger sitting sadly in her kennel. As soon as Buster saw Ginger his mother.... he struggled to get down from Becky's lap and ran towards her. Grandma was shocked. Becky said, "Grandma this is a magical dog who could talk to me,I don't want to keep him away from his mother. I want you to keephim here."

Grandma was touched to see how caring and thoughtful Becky was. She said, "Alright dear, they will stay together but promise you will come over and meet him every Sunday." Becky was happy to hear this and hugged her grandmother. She said goodbye to Buster and Ginger and went back home smiling.
